scripts.push:
echo '
⛔ push is DISABLED. drizzle-kit push DROPS COLUMNS to make the database match the schema, and this database has real data.

Use instead:
  pnpm sql ./sql/01-phase1-additive.sql     run a provided SQL file
  pnpm generate                             create a migration from schema changes
  pnpm migrate                              apply pending migrations

Back up first: pnpm backup
' && exit 1
scripts.push-force:
echo '
⛔ push-force is DISABLED and is the most destructive command in this repo.

--force skips drizzle-kit'\''s "this will drop column X" confirmation. It will silently destroy data.

Use pnpm generate + pnpm migrate instead. Never re-enable this script.
' && exit 1
